name: NOVAMSC
recent: Nova MSC 在2026年10月宣布获得价值1600万令吉的人形机器人订单，并在同月发布2026财年年报，其中审计报告包含与持续经营相关的保留意见。公司2026财年第四季度营收环比增长14.6%，但同比仍下降9.4%，净亏损为144万令吉。
notable: 获得价值1600万令吉的人形机器人订单（中国）。
2026财年年报的审计报告包含与持续经营相关的保留意见。
将于2026年12月14日召开第24届常年股东大会。
risks: 审计报告包含与持续经营相关的重大不确定性及保留意见。
2026财年第四季度净亏损144万令吉，净利率为-19.2%。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为752.4万令吉，环比增长14.6%，同比下降9.4%；净亏损144.1万令吉，净利率为-19.2%，较上一季度的-37.8%有所收窄。

recent_en: Nova MSC announced in October 2026 a RM16 million humanoid robot order and released its FY2026 annual report, which includes a qualified opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern. Revenue for 4QFY2026 rose 14.6% QoQ but fell 9.4% YoY, with a net loss of RM1.44 million.
notable_en: Secured a RM16 million humanoid robot order in China.
The FY2026 annual report's audit report includes a qualified opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern.
The 24th Annual General Meeting is scheduled for 14 December 2026.
risks_en: The audit report includes a material uncertainty related to going concern and a qualified opinion.
Net loss for 4QFY2026 was RM1.44 million, with a net margin of -19.2%.
earnings_en: For 4QFY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM7.524 million, up 14.6% QoQ but down 9.4% YoY; net loss was RM1.441 million with a net margin of -19.2%, compared with -37.8% in the previous quarter.
